value.rationale: The channel is a motivated asymmetric edit model introduced for DNA-storage applications, and the published results inspected are primarily constructive or asymptotic. A complete exact initial profile through length \(7\) is a natural finite benchmark: it quantifies short-block performance, provides exact test cases for constructions and bounds, and clarifies the strength of the either/or error model. The result is deliberately limited and makes no unsupported claim for larger lengths.
